name: Villain K/DA Evelynn
creator: wiko
description:
### ✨ Overview

This mod makes K/DA All Out Evelynn play "Villain" while in her passive form.

#

### ✨ Additional information

To use this mod, you need to own K/DA All Out Evelynn and pick her in champ select.
